About the residence

A home designed around the view

Set high above the city, this fully furnished three-bedroom apartment is designed around its views. Floor-to-ceiling windows run the length of the living space, framing the skyline and the sea and filling the home with natural light throughout the day.

The open-plan layout brings the living, dining and kitchen areas together into one generous space that works as well for quiet evenings as it does for entertaining. The modern kitchen is finished to a high standard, while soft, neutral interiors let the views take centre stage.

Across 2,200 sq ft, three well-proportioned bedrooms with built-in wardrobes are supported by four bathrooms. Two dedicated parking spaces, premium building amenities and easy access to retail, dining and leisure complete a home that is ready to move into.
